offer.speaker: iruka
offer.text: Water is harder than walls. It moves, so your chakra has to move with it.

offer.speaker: iruka
offer.text: Go to the lake south-west of the Academy and stand in the middle of it. On top of it, I mean!

steps.text: Stand on the water in the middle of the lake

dialogue.speaker: iruka
dialogue.text: Dry feet? Excellent. Naruto fell in four times today... don't tell him I told you.
